sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's mandatory biodiesel and biomass co-firing mandates create durable domestic offtake for renewable feedstock and power producers, insulating them from global demand swings.

US climate-tech faces persistent headwinds from high interest rates and policy uncertainty, favoring companies with contracted revenue or utility-scale project backlogs over early-stage technology.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian renewables names on domestic demand and policy tailwinds, led by TOBA and TPIA, while trimming US climate-tech exposure given rate sensitivity and weak sentiment. Focus on downstream processing, captive power, and electrification plays with local revenue visibility; avoid speculative hydrogen and fuel-cell names until margins prove out.

Rotate into food-service and specialty retail sub-sectors with earnings momentum, avoid broad index exposure. Target 3-6 week horizon, set tight stops at 5% below entry given normal signal volatility.
